title: Add --no-caffeinate flag to rocket loop
description: Add an optional --no-caffeinate flag to the loop command. When passed, skip the caffeinate.start() call even on macOS. Useful for CI environments.
acceptanceCriteria: --no-caffeinate flag is registered on the loop command
rocket loop --no-caffeinate runs without starting caffeinate
caffeinate is not listed as a running process when --no-caffeinate is used

steps.details: In src/cli.ts loop command registration, add: .option('--no-caffeinate', 'Skip caffeinate sleep prevention (useful for CI)')

steps.description: Pass caffeinate flag to loop runner
steps.details: In loop.ts, extract: const noCaffeinate = options.caffeinate === false (Commander uses 'caffeinate' for --no-caffeinate negation). Pass to loop runner options: noCaffeinate: !options.caffeinate

steps.description: Conditionally skip caffeinate in loop runner
steps.details: In runLoop: const caffProc = options.noCaffeinate ? null : caffeinate.start(). The existing stop(null) call is already a no-op.

technicalNotes: Commander's --no-X flag pattern: .option('--no-X', '...') makes options.x be true by default and false when --no-x is passed
